text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, who's the one who said
the distance was too short, huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Kitasan Black
has done it again... this time too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Haah, haah... There's nothing I'm good at. I can't do anything flashy. But—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Weaknesses don't mean a thing! Because I've properly
overcome every single one of them.
Whether it's 2,000 or 3,000 meters, I can do it!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(We did it, Dia-chan. With this, we've cleared
our first goal of the year!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This run—reach them!
choice_data_list: Kitasan, well done. On to the next one.
You did great, Kitasan. On to the next one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Yes!
There's nothing I can't do, and no road
I can't run all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I did it this time, so I can definitely do it next time too!
Even on a long slope over 3,000 meters!
Even if the prize I'm aiming for is that dazzling shield!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Tenno Sho (Spring)! I'll show them!
To prove that anyone can reach the crown if they work hard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black just, how do I put it...
she gives you energy. Just... watching her...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It makes you feel like even we could do it.
If we work hard like that, surely someday...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You've returned. Good work.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It seems there are no lingering effects from the surgery.
After her comeback race domestically,
this fine GⅠ performance in the UAE..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Have you gotten most of your groove back?

text_block_list.name: Brusqueman
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am…….

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A lot has happened since then. Even while
you were away on your overseas campaign, quite a bit went down.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"What will we do for the next race?
Though that also depends on your Trainer's intentions..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Wanna go pick some flowers or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A replacement for the chrysanthemum flower
I forgot to pick last year, somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With our next goal, the Tenno Sho (Spring), ahead of us,
various movements were beginning to stir all around us.
